description.html: The Arcadia UVB compact bulb with 7% UVB output and 23W is a versatile option suitable for a wide range of reptiles. UVB radiation helps synthesize vitamin D3, which is essential for calcium absorption and healthy bone development. The 7% output sits between the forest and desert options, making this bulb suitable for leopard geckos, smaller snakes, smaller agamas and many other popular species.

The compact E27 form allows easy installation in ceramic holders. The recommended distance from the animal is 20-30cm for an optimal UVB level. The bulb needs to be replaced every 6-12 months, because UVB output gradually weakens even if the visible light stays the same.
